title: Ko ƴattaade e daande maayo
intro: Aɗa darii e dow ceene daande maayo yejjittaango, ɗo ɓuuɓol ngol ɓuuɓnata renndo jarriborngo yamiroore Alla. Henndu nduu ina teddi e siftorde fenaande addannde waylo-waylo hulɓiniingo. Hol ɓeen ɓerɗe, hol sifaa ñaawoore maɓɓe?
clues: En ngonnoo ko renndo keɓngo yamiroore laaɓtunde ummoraade e Joomiraawo men, tee en keɓii laabi ngam salaade ɗum.
Min nguurnoo ko sara ndiyam, nguurndam amen fawii ko e tagooje mum.
Jarribo arii e men ñalnde min njamiraa yo min ngoppu geɗe aduna.
Tagooje ndiyam ɗee ngari e men e oon ñalawma, ina jarriboo en haa ɓurti.
Min peewni feere fenaande ngam taartude yamiroore Alla, min cikki min mbaawi ɓurde yamiroore ndee.
Juumre men addani en waylo-waylo huɓɓungo; en ngontii apes jirmaaɗi he yamiroore Alla.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Konu colli neldaama haɓde e maɓɓe

arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
